reason: Superseded by ETP-4852's system-level template roles (SystemRoleTemplates + per-user AD_Role_Inheritance composition via UserRoleCompositionService). R16's own @check has no awareness it was superseded and would keep firing for any untouched tenant, recreating obsolete per-client Finance/Sales/Purchasing/Inventory role clones -- and could re-insert AD_Window_Access rows onto an already-deactivated legacy role (see R27-deactivate-r16-duplicate-roles.sql) if the reference client (GOClient) ever gains a new grant on one of those 4 roles later. R16's .sql file itself stays byte-for-byte untouched (already applied to real tenants, immutable, checksum tracked here) -- this retirement list is the mechanism, not an edit to the fix.

Superseded by the Standard-cost remediation path. R18 seeded Average-cost M_Costing rows (costtype AVA), but Etendo Go now provisions and validates Standard costing rules, whose posting-time lookup requires Standard/legacy Standard costs (costtype STA/ST). Keeping R18 active would add obsolete Average anchors that do not satisfy the current Standard-cost checks and can mislead future investigations. The original .sql file stays byte-for-byte untouched and is skipped through the retirement mechanism.

Its effect 2 enforces the ETP-4503 exception that forced multicurrency OFF on the bank-transfer link of PSD2-connected Bank accounts, which ETP-5084 removed: a PIS transfer converts the invoice amount to the account currency before instructing the bank, so a cross-currency transfer is supported and that link is multicurrency like every other payment method. R14's @check has no awareness it was superseded -- on an untouched tenant it would re-apply the removed exception, and on an already-fixed tenant R14 and R29 would fight on every run (R29 turns the link on, R14 turns it back off). R14's .sql stays byte-for-byte untouched (already applied to real tenants, immutable, checksum tracked here). R29 is a strict superset of R14's still-wanted effects 1a + 1b: it enables both multicurrency columns on every method template and every per-account link, with no exception.

Obsoleted -- NOT superseded -- by ETP-5079, which removes the synthetic "Default Customer" business partner from onboarding entirely (OnboardingDefaultCustomerService and its call site in EtendoGoJwtServlet#ensureOnboardingDataset are deleted). R4 exists for the sole purpose of giving that BP (c_bpartner.value = 'ONBOARDING_DEFAULT_CUSTOMER') a currency, a C_Location/C_BPartner_Location address and a linked AD_User contact on tenants onboarded before that wiring existed. With the BP no longer provisioned for new tenants, and with the business decision on ETP-5079 being that existing tenants are NOT repaired, R4 has nothing left to accomplish: on a tenant that never had the BP its @check already returns 0 rows, and on a legacy tenant that still has one it would keep minting an address and a contact user for a partner the product has decided should not exist -- including exactly the "Default Customer Contact" AD_User that ETP-5079 stops creating. Retiring it prevents that contradiction. No replacement fix is shipped, so supersededBy is deliberately empty. R4's .sql file stays byte-for-byte untouched (already applied to real tenants, immutable, checksum tracked here) -- this retirement list is the mechanism, not an edit to the fix.
